title: Popover
description: Popover anchors compact, interactive panels to an existing trigger. Use it for filters, pickers, share sheets, and quick workflows that need more room than a tooltip but less weight than a dialog.
intro: Popover is exposed as a standalone directive on a trigger element. Pass an `ng-template` with the panel body, toggle it on click by default, and optionally control open state from the parent.

featureSections.title: Filter panel on a board
featureSections.description: A common production pattern is a filter trigger on a dense list or board. The popover hosts switch rows, helper copy, and confirm actions without navigating away.

featureSections.title: Placement with fallback
featureSections.description: Choose the preferred side for the anchored panel. The overlay falls back when viewport space is limited and keeps the arrow aligned with the side that actually rendered.

featureSections.title: Assignee picker
featureSections.description: Issue workflows often need search, avatars, and secondary actions in a compact anchored panel. This is a better popover fit than a tooltip or full dialog.

featureSections.title: Controlled column picker
featureSections.description: Bind `uiPopoverOpen` when the parent owns the open state. Column toggles work well as switch rows with labels aligned on the right.

featureSections.title: Share and access
featureSections.description: Share popovers usually combine invites, link access, and a short list of people who already have permissions—without turning into a second dialog.

accessibility.title: Trigger semantics
accessibility.body: The trigger receives `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` while open. Provide `uiPopoverAriaLabel` when the panel heading is not obvious from the trigger alone.

accessibility.title: Keyboard and dismissal
accessibility.body:
Popover panels close on `Escape` and outside pointer interaction. Keep essential instructions visible outside the popover when users must understand the trigger before opening it.

| Key / input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Click trigger | Toggles the popover when `uiPopoverTrigger` is `click` |
| Escape | Closes the open popover |
| Outside click | Closes the open popover |

accessibility.title: Popover versus tooltip
accessibility.body: Use tooltip for short, non-interactive hints. Use popover when the surface needs buttons, inputs, or richer supporting content that users may interact with.

apiSections.title: PopoverDirective - [uiPopover]
apiSections.lead: Standalone directive that anchors a CDK overlay popover to an existing trigger element. It supports click or hover activation, preferred placement with viewport fallback, optional arrow rendering, and a two-way open model.

blocks.title: Inputs
rows: Required template with the popover body content.
Two-way bound open state for controlled usage.
Preferred placement for the anchored panel.
Activation mode for opening the popover.
Shows the pointer arrow on the anchored surface.
Controls the max width of the popover surface.
Accessible name for the dialog surface when needed.
Delay in milliseconds before opening on hover.
Delay in milliseconds before closing on hover leave.

paragraphs: Structure panel content with header, body, and footer sections when the surface includes confirm/cancel actions or grouped controls.
Popover overlays use pointer events, unlike tooltip overlays, so buttons and inputs inside the panel remain interactive.
